target: CHOP losses: positions with net<0 and gross<0 whose max favourable excursion reached 0.3R-1R (moved our way, then reversed). Baseline: 508 positions, -145.2% of equity (sum of net/equity-at-entry), full period @2bps.
baseline: validated package: 15 symbols, 6 slots, R=0.75%, 4B + V2 + BTC gate + initial stop 2.5 ATR (high_cagr/chop_harness.py). Full @2bps: Calmar 1.879.

fail_exit.A: exit at the 4h close when price closes back inside the breakout level (max(Donchian-10 high, Kumo top) at entry, mirrored for shorts)
fail_exit.B: exit when a 4h close is back inside the Kumo edge at entry

time_stop.A: exit at a 4h close after 12 bars (48h) if MFE never reached 1R

tight_trail.A: once MFE >= 1R, trail on the 4-bar opposite extreme instead of 10
tight_trail.B: once MFE >= 1.5R, trail on the 3-bar extreme

chop_index.A: entry only if Choppiness Index(14) on 4h < 61.8

efficiency_ratio.A: entry only if Kaufman efficiency ratio over 20 bars >= 0.30

gate: imp_harness.verdict against this baseline (@2 and @5bps: positive H1/H2/2026, full Calmar >= baseline+0.05, full DD <= baseline, Calmar >= baseline in H1 and H2; old-5 and new-10 not worse) AND CHOP cost cut >= 15%
holdout: HOLD10 has already been used once, so it is no longer clean. Any in-sample pass goes to a NEW holdout (the next 10 symbols by Sep-2021 liquidity, same rules incl. funding completeness), declared before download.
decision: Results only; no bot change without the user's confirmation.
